The cause was a      representation mismatch, not a missing precompile. A Solidity memory array gives      every element a full 32-byte word, the wire format is 8 bytes, so every call packed      on the way in and unpacked on the way out, one element at a time, forever.      Keeping activations packed end to end means a layer's data is never reshaped.
